sentences.text: No, the documents do not state that the lender is required to offer EMI-based personal loan borrowers (UCB Tier 3) the option to switch to a fixed interest rate at reset; they say the REs "may, at its option," provide that choice as per their Board approved policy.

The same wording appears in the bank’s own policy: "At the time of reset of the floating rate, the Bank may, at its option, offer the borrower a choice to switch to a fixed rate as per its Board approved policy."
The documents do not state any Tier 3 UCB-specific requirement that changes this optional wording for the reset of floating rate EMI based personal loans.

missing.slot: whether a mandatory offer applies specifically to UCB Tier 3 at interest rate reset
